joy.title: Caring for Your Mental Health
joy.description: General self-care overview from a federal mental-health research agency: what self-care means, and how it supports ongoing wellbeing (not tied to any specific emotion or diagnosis).

sadness.title: Depression: Overview and Where to Learn More
sadness.description: Educational overview of low mood/depression from NIMH, including where to find more information and how to find professional help. This is general information, not a diagnosis.

anger.title: Anger Management: 10 Tips to Tame Your Temper
anger.description: Practical, medically reviewed tips for managing anger in the moment and over time, from a nonprofit academic medical center.

fear.title: Anxiety Disorders
fear.description: Overview of anxiety and worry, common signs, and options for getting support, from a federal mental-health research agency.

stress.title: 20 Ways to Relieve Stress
stress.description: Practical, expert-reviewed stress-relief techniques covering daily habits, relaxation, and when to seek extra support.

confusion.title: Meditation and Mindfulness: What You Need to Know
confusion.description: Introductory, research-based overview of mindfulness practices that can help with noticing and naming emotions when they feel unclear.
confusion.source: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH)

neutral.title: Caring for Your Mental Health
neutral.description: General wellbeing self-care overview, suitable as a default resource when no specific emotion category stands out.
